translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Ngeni ngaba hania hania nga ikocfaka amma keracmanganggac faka wama ngicngac mi demanganeyunubisia.

content.text: KEBU ye gombunga, ngeni imoc bic tobanggegec. (Mitiyegec 34:8)

content: Imocac ngeni sabac gboriango namuac ammiande, ifi isoc Asuac arennu namu kongaha imocac angemmebeso. Ngeni imoc nema yadimagec yeng ebicfunac mesingunuu komoc kpegecde.
Kebu ye hoctoa kekehagoc, ngeni yearu habisia. Ngic yeneng hoc imocac hoc mangana dema meickegec. Nga Anutungo imocac negenu siriha engena anu imocnoc meisinggeec.

Nga ngeni ifingoc hoc kekehagoc yeac siric andae. Nga Anutungo asu ama mengunuande. Mengunuu ngeni yengena womong gareng kpetiac amma Asuac sinnu sese faigecde, imoc Yesuac amma Anutungo henu ngereeude.
Imocac mitikibiu yoac yofi oho ohoya fede,

content.text: “Negenggec, ni hocwotung mong siriha engena imoc meisinggema Sionnu gununggebade. Ngic mongngo ye negensinggeude, ye gamekpekpeu naric mi enude.” (Yesaia 28:16)

content: Ngicngac ye negensinggema kecdae, ngenearu hoc imocngo siriha engena ande. Nga mi negensinggedae, yenearu yofi fingerude,

content.text: “Amameme ngic yeneng hoc mong mangana dema ukugec. Nga hoc imocngo amaac hoc wotung amma seria nanude.” (Mitiyegec 118:22)
“Nga yeni hoc imohai kpondzong heigecde nga peperandziu tifainggema negemmangang meficgegecde.” (Yesaia 8:14)

content: Yeni Anutuac yoac kpeandaeac ifi anggecde, yoac imoc yeneac bic dedea.

content.text: Anu ngeni Anutuac faka kuhagoc dekperagigecdeac Anutungo ngeneac areng meisingngunuec. Meisingngunuma ngeni yengena areng ngicngac kpetiac anggecdeac mengunuma ngictauac arennu faingunuu womong garengua mekecgecde. (Makekeng 19:5-6; Yesaia 43:20)

content: Yennoc kundunnunac hagecdeac kpacngunuma kperagiau heitaingunuma yengena kperagi engena, imohai faingunuec.
Ngeni warac ngicngac areng mocgu mi kecgec, kpac. Nga yaguc Anutuac ngicngacfora amma yeac areng kecdae. Ngeni warac Anutuac wosoefac mong mi hengkecgec. Nga yofinenggac yeac wosoefac hemma kecdae.
Songo tosofocna, ngeni bangec yomohai kuric kecdae, imocac ngeni uba eseaac negensongo hania haniango ubaonganginagoc dzikac kpeande nga ngeni imoc wama kecgecdeac gorongina kpema deduae.

Ngeni bangec monnunac ngicngac, yeneac botucfu faka nga angammeme gombunga angkecbisia. Ifi anggec yeni ngeneac dedeseriyoac kpekpeareng dema enacfu faifai angemmema angammemengina gombunga henggecde. Ifi hemmagec Anutungo yeni yugucyunuu naso imohai dengeregecde.
Ngeni Kebuac amma kia gawamang, yeneac enac tofohobisia. Imoc ngictaungo kuc sasawa mekecde nga
yeac bageau gawana sasawa. Yeng uayoac yemmeu yeneng ngicngac angammemengina mangana angkecdae, yeneac turung kpouyemmegecde. Nga faka gombunga angkecdae, yeni dengereyunugecde.
Ngic yeni negen isingngina kpac wiac mong mi negentegecdae, imoc ngeni angammemengina gombungango enacngina midomebisia, imocngo Anutuac songo ande.
Ngeni witicfu mi kecdae nga witiha kpac kekec, imocngo angammemengina mangana mi kperahebeso, kpac. Ngeni Anutuac wanac areng kecbisia.
Amma ngeni ngicngac sasawa ewengina heima negen negensinggoc tosofocngina heresongogoc hoangyunubisia nga Anutuac damungunuu ngictau eweheimibisia.
Wanacngic kecdae, ngeni mingingfocngina yeneac enac hafoangoc modacma ewengina heima kecbisia. Ngeni mingingfocngina yumea nga gombunga amma gori goria momoc ifingoc ayemmekecbisia.
Ngic mong ye Anutuac yoac ubahereau feu imoc modaru goango kopocsiha kpac hemmaguc sifu ebicfu faigec kpendzeng kpeudeu faka imocngo danggunuhagoc anude.

Nga ngic yeneng kopocsicnginaac amma ngunugec ngeni kpendzennu emma imocac bageu seria kecgecdeu imocngo dedengerecac wiac mong mi ande, kpac. Ngeni ine angammemengina gombunga ammagec kpendzennu faingunugec imocac bageu seria kecgecde, imocngo Anutuaru danggunuhagoc anude.
Ngeni ifi anggecdeac Anutungo kpacngunuec. Anu ngeni Kristoac hanititi modacgecdeac yeng ngeneac amma kpendzeng kpema sing imoc edzacngunuec.

content.text: Ye kopocsic mong mi meficgeec amma yeac enacfunac ikocyoac mong mi negenggec. (Yesaia 53:9)

content: Nga yeni defagoc ammigec yeng turunga sowecyoac mong mi merenec. Nga kpendzeng kpema dekengec mong mi ayemmeec, kpac. Ye ebiha Anutungo yoac dindingac desikecde, yeac mariu faiemeec.
Ye yengena sebiango nenang kopocsic atickema icfu nanec. Nanu nenang kopocsicfunac homema sing dindingac modacnideac ifi anec. Nga yeac kubecngo ngeni hafeidzoicfunac ngerec ngeree meficgengemmeec.
Ngeni warac rama isoc sing segema kecgec. Nga yofinenggac ramagarenggaru bic dzigenegec yennoc ubaongangina henggareng angemmeude.
